title: Cookie policy
notice: This site only uses technical cookies needed to work and a cookie-free, self-hosted analytics tool. No ads, no third-party tracking.
sections: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. There are also similar technologies, such as local storage.
Analytics are self-hosted (Umami, on my own server) and use no cookies. There are no advertising or social media cookies.
Technical storage strictly necessary to provide the requested service is exempt from consent under Article 22.2 of Spain’s LSSI. This notice is informational.
You can delete or block cookies and local storage in your browser settings.
Any changes to this policy will be posted here.
